description: This file defines a template class 'span' for representing a view over a contiguous sequence of elements, along with related utility functions, type traits, and comparison operators. It is part of the Chromium project's base namespace and provides a lightweight, non-owning array view similar to std::span.

classes.name: span
classes.description: A template class representing a non-owning view over a contiguous sequence of elements of type T, with support for subviews, element access, and comparison.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a span representing the first 'Count' elements.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a span representing the last 'Count' elements.

methods.name: subspan
methods.description: Returns a subview starting at 'offset' with length 'count'.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the span.

methods.name: size_bytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the span in bytes.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the span is empty.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying data.
